copy_script:
@echo off
if exist C:\xwn600-kit goto fail
mkdir C:\xwn600-kit
copy D:\FIXTURE.DLL C:\xwn600-kit\FIXTURE.DLL
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\SUBJECT.EXE C:\xwn600-kit\SUBJECT.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\TRACE.EXE C:\xwn600-kit\TRACE.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\RUN600.EXE C:\xwn600-kit\RUN600.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
attrib -R C:\xwn600-kit\*.*
echo XWN600 READY - EJECT CD BEFORE RUNNING
exit
:fail
echo COPY FAILED
pause
